resource.carbon_price_basis: social cost of carbon, US EPA 2023
resource.name: Costa Brava Posidonia Meadow

notes: Marine externality costs are ANNUAL (€/yr) — they recur every year the damage persists. Posidonia recovers at 1-6 cm/year; damage is effectively permanent on human timescales. The net social cost compares the one-off revenue with the present value of these annual losses.

pricing.note: EXPERIMENTAL (decision D4, C8): endogenous pricing is quarantined. Every price is certified convergent (a run that cannot be certified fails instead of falling back to static values), but the formulation counts upstream value once per dependent agent and prices the whole loss at the end-state scarcity price, and most shipped anchors are placeholders. Do not use these figures as estimates.

annual_externality_band.method: HEURISTIC, not a statistical interval: annual externality x (1 +/- (1 - model confidence)), the confidence set by the resilience zone (gaia.resilience.compute_confidence_band). A Monte Carlo interval is pending (Step 8).
